Vendored Pyodide runtime, release 314.0.7 (core files only; no optional Pyodide packages).
Files pyodide.mjs, pyodide.asm.mjs, pyodide.asm.wasm, python_stdlib.zip were compared byte for byte with the official release
asset https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide/releases/download/314.0.7/pyodide-core-314.0.7.tar.bz2 and are identical.
(That tarball ships no license files, so notices below come from the sources the build pins.)

Components linked into pyodide.asm.wasm per the 314.0.7 build files (Makefile.envs and cpython/Makefile at tag 314.0.7), and the license file collected for each:
 - Pyodide, hiwire (Pyodide's own repo, MPL-2.0): Pyodide-MPL-2.0.txt, hiwire-LICENSE.txt (hiwire at pinned commit 6a1e672)
 - CPython 3.14.2 (PSF license): CPython-3.14.2-LICENSE.txt
 - libmpdec and expat (bundled inside CPython): libmpdec-header-license.txt (from the file header, no separate file in 3.14.2), expat-COPYING.txt
 - libffi (pinned commit f08493d): libffi-LICENSE.txt
 - xz / liblzma 5.2.2: xz-5.2.2-COPYING.txt
 - zstd 1.5.7: zstd-1.5.7-LICENSE.txt
 - sqlite 3.39.0: sqlite-public-domain.txt
 - zlib 1.3.1 (inflate banner found in the wasm) and bzip2 (Emscripten ports, -sUSE_ZLIB -sUSE_BZIP2): zlib-LICENSE.txt, bzip2-1.0.6-LICENSE.txt (bzip2 port version 1.0.6 confirmed from Emscripten 5.0.3 tools/ports/bzip2.py; license file from the emscripten-ports/bzip2 1.0.6 tag)
 - Emscripten 5.0.3 (MIT / NCSA), its musl libc and libc++: Emscripten-5.0.3-LICENSE.txt, musl-COPYRIGHT.txt, libcxx-LICENSE.txt
Emscripten 5.0.3 LLVM runtime libraries (Apache-2.0 with LLVM Exceptions, license files taken from the Emscripten 5.0.3 tag): libcxx-LICENSE.txt, LLVM-libcxxabi-LICENSE.txt, LLVM-libunwind-LICENSE.txt, LLVM-compiler-rt-LICENSE.txt.
Limits: the exact list of Emscripten system libraries linked into the wasm was not read from the binary; the build files and the list above are the basis. Any other component found later should be added.
Not legal advice. Pyodide MPL-2.0 (a file-level copyleft) applies to the files unmodified here; keep them unmodified.
